details: One of the things that I thought would be great if you set up to accept payments from credit and debit cards directly to vrchat it would help in the purchase of the points in other platforms being an issue like with steam you have to launch it in desktop mode to be able to pull up to buy the points or renew your subscription secondly if you disallow the accepting of prepaid you could also use it as an age verification and disable anyone that doesn't have the age verification from seeing suggestive avatars by implementing this check is optional you can include all the current players as well as limit the rampant issues related to children on the platform it should also make moderation easier and improving the security and feeling of safe spaces not everyone gets along some people don't like interacting with kids and allowing these opt in options should make the platform safer for both adults and kids you could also implement in your system that you can Auto gift vrchat Plus to your kids as a subscription option with administrative controls over toggling off extra features like not wanting their kids to see horror and thereby implementing an adult safety net and system and with the more identifiers making it easier to permanently ban offenders of the platform.
title: Filtering and controlling the available features in VR chat
